subject: Scheduling: Console + API dual-track training for Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acme-analytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dual-track training request (console + API)

Hi Mina / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the stakeholders here at Acme Analytics want to move to a short, focused onboarding for two teams: a console walkthrough for product and analytics (non-engineers), and a hands-on API enablement for our infra/ML engineers.

High-level asks:
- Console session (60–75 mins): UI, role-based permissions, dashboards, cost/usage reporting.
- API session (90 mins): auth, example calls, hot-starting models, and a brief Q&A for our infra team.

We have participants across US and APAC. Preferred week is the week of July 12; flexible on format (split sessions or back-to-back). Can you propose slots? Also would like the sessions recorded and for any prework (API keys, sample model) to be clarified.

Attendees: Ellen Park (PM), Samir Roy (Lead ML Eng) — I cc'd Samir here.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Senior Product Manager
Acme Analytics

--
Attachment: request_notes.txt (text)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dual-track training request (console + API)

Hi Ellen — great to hear and happy to run both. We can split into two focused sessions (recommended) so each audience gets the right level of detail. I'll bring Dev Patel from our infra team on the API deep-dive.

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Option A: Console walkthrough — Tue, Jul 13, 10:00–11:15 (60–75m)
- Option B: API deep-dive — Wed, Jul 14, 09:00–10:30 (90m)
- Option C (APAC-friendly): API deep-dive — Wed, Jul 14, 18:00–19:30 (90m) if you need evening to cover APAC colleagues.

I've attached a preliminary agenda (training_agenda_v1.pdf) and can adjust priorities if you want more hands-on labs. We record by default and can share the recording and slides afterwards.

Can you confirm preferred options and whether you want the sessions split across two days or back-to-back on the same day? Also let me know if Samir needs any specific auth or sample payloads ahead of time so Dev can prep.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

--

From: Samir Roy <samir.roy@acme-analytics.com>

Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dual-track training request (console + API)

Thanks Mina — splitting is preferable. A couple of notes from the engineering side:
- We have APAC engineers who would prefer the 18:00 PDT slot (Option C).
- If possible, we'd like the API session to include a small hands-on lab where we run a few sample calls against a sandbox model. Do you provide short-lived API keys for labs?
- Also: we have an internal compliance pre-check; could you share the short agenda for legal/security review?

If Wed 14 Jul 18:00 PDT works, that would be my preference for the API session. For the console walkthrough, Tue 13 Jul 10:00 PDT is fine for our product folks.

Samir Roy
Lead ML Engineer
Acme Analytics

Hi Ellen / Samir — thanks for the quick replies. Confirming the plan below and I'll send calendar invites in the next 30 minutes.

Schedule (PDT):
- Tue, Jul 13 | Console walkthrough | 10:00–11:15 PDT | Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
- Wed, Jul 14 | API lab (hands-on) | 18:00–19:30 PDT | Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (same room)

What we'll provide ahead of the API lab:
- Short-lived sandbox API keys (Dev will provision; expect a separate email with keys + usage limits)
- A minimal sample payload and curl/snippet repo in the Drive folder linked below
- Agenda for your security team (we include data retention, auth, and logging topics)

Thanks and looking forward to it — I'll send invites and an updated agenda after Dev confirms the sandbox availability.
